title: Activists block access to Diehl Defence factory in Lübben
seoTitle: Lübben protest at Diehl Defence factory

tea.why: Protesters oppose the production of weapons and German arms exports to Israel.
tea.want: An end to weapons production and exports to Israel.
tea.changed: Nov 16: Activists began a week-long protest campaign by blocking the entrance to the Diehl Defence facility in Lübben.

summary: On the morning of November 16, 2026, activists from the group 'Peacefully Against Genocide' began a blockade of the Diehl Defence factory entrance in Lübben, Brandenburg. The action is intended to be the start of a week-long protest campaign against the production of weapons and German arms exports to Israel. The blockade has caused traffic disruptions on the L42 road, with both directions closed between Börnichen and the B87. Police in Cottbus reported that approximately 20 to 30 people were involved, while the organisers claimed about 50 participants were present. The site, known as the Spreewerk, was historically a munitions factory and is currently being expanded by Diehl Defence and the Tauber Group for the production of munitions components.
response: Police in Cottbus are monitoring the situation and have warned of traffic restrictions on the L42 due to the blockade.

crowd.text: Organisers claimed about 50 activists were present, while police reported 20 to 30 people.

updates.text: Activists began a blockade at the Diehl Defence factory in Lübben as part of a planned week of protest actions.
